name: Banner
purpose: The page-level, persistent member of the feedback family: a full-width solid RAG surface that sits above the content it governs and stays until the condition clears or the user dismisses it. Use for conditions that apply to the whole page or session (service outage, device verification, expiring card) — not for in-flow validation (Alert) or transient confirmations (Toast).

props.name: status
props.$note: Binds the R-D20 rag/{status}-background fill + its most specific ruled ink (see tokens). Error renders role="alert".

props.name: actions
props.$note: Up to two ghost actions — mutually exclusive with dismiss (Legacy family shape rule kept).

variants.name: error
variants.use: Page/session-level failure needing action; the ONE white-type surface IN BASE/MONO (type26-013 — white is red-only; fill #B92F1E, 6.02:1); assertive. s131-D1 (#131): in LEGACY white type also rides success and information — the red-only clause is base-scoped.

variants.name: warning
variants.use: Page-level caution; amber always carries near-black ink (R-D3).

variants.name: success
variants.use: Page-level confirmation that should persist; black ink (text/on-success, B-D6 precedent). s131-D1 (#131): legacy overrides text/on-success to WHITE on its teal #00847F (4.56:1).

variants.name: information
variants.use: Service notice; rag/text/on-information ink (minted s131-D1 #131 — base = the on-light dark ink; legacy reverses to white on its dark blue #305A85, 7.17:1). Formerly bound rag/text/on-light.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — copy .t-ed-body (.em title); actions .t-cm-button + .t-cm-slot
tokens.surface: rag/{error,warning,success,information}-background — the R-D20 solid fills (Mono precedent: Button is-success)
tokens.ink: error = rag/text/on-dark (white, red-only surface) · warning = rag/text/on-light · information = rag/text/on-information (minted s131-D1; base equals the on-light ink) · success = text/on-success. 5.22–9.16:1 both modes in base; legacy legs per s131-D1: 7.87 / 11.57 / 7.17 / 4.56.
tokens.glyph: reverse-knockout — shape = the variant ink, internal mark = the fill (--mark), so icon legs match the declared text pairs
tokens.states: action/dismiss overlays = color-mix of the INK at 14%/22% (active > hover); press physics pending button-family partial injection (ADR-0013)

motion.dismiss: Immediate removal (page-level surfaces do not animate away by default).

responsive.rule: Full-width fluid; actions stack full-width at ≤480px container (verified to 320px, 1.4.10). Icon anchors to the first text line.

mustNotNeighbour: A second banner (one page-level message at a time)

accessibility.name: Dismiss carries aria-label="Dismiss banner"; glyphs aria-hidden (title carries meaning — colour never the sole channel).
accessibility.keyboard: Link, actions and dismiss are tabbable; Enter/Space activate.
accessibility.focus: Visible :focus-visible outlines (2px ink) on link, actions and dismiss.
accessibility.nonText: Glyph legs ≥4.5:1 (they reuse the text pairs); banner fill vs page carries no indicator floor — the surface is not an indicator (1.4.11).

antiPatterns: Actions AND dismiss on the same banner (family shape rule: either, never both)
White type on any fill except the red error fill (type26-013)
Two banners stacked (one page-level message at a time; queue or consolidate)
Using a banner for in-flow form validation (Alert) or transient confirmation (Toast)
Re-implementing press physics locally on actions/dismiss (ADR-0013 ratchet)
Hardcoding RAG hexes instead of rag/*-background roles

tokenValidation.against: token store (semantic-colour.json, R-D20 -background fills + ruled inks) via #token-manifest
tokenValidation.result: PASS — bound vars match resolved light+dark; declared text pairs 5.22–9.16:1 both modes; icon legs reuse the text pairs (reverse-knockout).
tokenValidation.$note: Built Phase-2 wave 1 (worker B). Pressables await button-family $members registration (conductor); empty AUTO-PARTIAL pair in place.

mustNotNeighbour.$note: A second banner (one page-level message at a time)

actions.use: Holds the banner's response actions; the container lays them out but never authors them.
actions.$status: ruled s140-D2 (Dave, 2026-08-09, via SLOTS-DRAFT-REVIEW s140-v1 export)
